findings.claim: The installer overwrites `.codex/config.toml`, clobbering existing Codex project configuration instead of installing only generated role files without touching native config.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria state exports must be installed "without clobbering existing native configuration" and the Decisions section says `install-exports.mjs` "copies only role files from staging to their harness location"; the diff adds `export const CODEX_CONFIG = ".codex/config.toml"` and in `main()` writes it with `writeFileSync(codexConfig, wantConfig)` when not in `--check`, while docs/agent-team.md also says `.codex/config.toml` is "wholly generated" and edits are overwritten.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not own the entire `.codex/config.toml`; either generate a separate includeable/team-owned config if Codex supports it, or parse/merge only `[agents.<id>]` blocks while preserving unrelated settings, and refuse to overwrite an existing non-generated config without an explicit migration path.

findings.claim: MiniMax committable-file validation silently succeeds when `git ls-files` fails, masking possible runtime credential files under `.minimax`.
findings.evidence: `minimaxCommittableProblems()` runs `spawnSync("git", ["ls-files", ...])` and immediately returns `[]` when `r.status !== 0`, even though README/docs warn MiniMax runtime data can hold credentials and the QA evidence relies on this check to ensure only generated files are committable.
findings.suggested_fix: Return a lint problem when `git ls-files` exits non-zero, including stderr/stdout, so CI fails closed if the committable-file check cannot run.
